sentences.text: Seven decisions wait on you, and the first is to approve the schema change so the import can run on real data; it was asked twice and is costing you now.
You delivered 7 this week against 5 the week before, and tokens per delivery came down to about 300k from 332k, though waiting time grew to over 400 hours from over 60.
The most unusual thing is that the question of whether the export ships in this release has waited 9 days, while lead's asks are usually answered in hours.
